name: Prospective strict attempt3 with RF eligibility
authorization: Claude: one later strict attempt3, all3 originals, unchanged thresholds; RF probe tail<0.5%,30-minute deferrals,up to4 retries; Astra approval before use

campaign.scope: Exactly one new3-original population. All attempt1/2/item1 failures remain unchanged. Ordinary scored failures remain failures while remaining originals are collected; fatal failures stop incomplete. No scored-population restart or replacement. Existing room/NIC gates remain before every prompt.

probe.capture: Existing authenticated receiver rtp/rtp.jsonl, MAX_PACKETS=20000; retain complete raw data plus one-second endpoint margins, packet/status evidence, full serial bytes/audio-state ledger, bot events, before/after PERF and NIC
probe.window: Declare start/end before observing gaps. One continuous peer/SSRC; fixed60seconds after greeting completes, gate reopens and6seconds of settled uplink. No fitted subwindows, startup/idle/console/fault exclusions or pooled retries. Minimum2850 adjacent intervals validates continuous nominal50Hz capture, not a relaxed tail denominator.
probe.operating_state: Frozen normal9936da45, AECoff, same1100-byte SCTP chunks, live-test bot, cat30fps, quiet1, volume0, audio1 and mic gate open. No fixture/prompt playback, TTS, mic export, arrival export or full PERF during window. Quiet room means idle speech, never audio0. Before/after PERF only.
probe.missing_evidence: Unscored eligibility deferral; retain raw evidence/reason and consume a probe opportunity. Raw errors, spontaneous boots, DMA, memory/stack/allocation/lock faults or cleanup errors are fatal and must not be converted to RF deferrals.
probe.health: Existing strict byte monitor with no bot-loss exemptions, all raw PERF memory/stack/lock/failed-allocation gates, display alive, same identity and clean cleanup. Record exact failures. wlp8s0 total RX+TX<=20MB/300s scaled to interval; enp7s0 recorded only. No network/mixer/geometry changes.
probe.admission: Complete raw replay and health/NIC checks before any scored prompt. tail_count*200<eligible_interval_count (strictly below0.5%); report existing max/extreme statistics separately. Probe result is not a scored turn or firmware PASS.
probe.handoff: After admission launch attempt3 immediately within the same short bench hold, unchanged frozen image and gate definitions. Separate probe and scored RTP outputs/peer identifiers; never count probe packets/turns toward the campaign. If the hold/image/environment must change before launch, stop and record unstarted; no silently reused admission.

deferrals.entries: Append-only explicit completed=true and exact boolean eligible/fatal/scored=false disposition; finite UTC+monotonic start/end, probe index1..5, raw paths+hashes, expected ELF+observed boot hash, window boundaries, tail numerator/denominator/rate/max/extreme, coverage/truncation/activity, raw/resource/cleanup/NIC verdicts, reason,scored=false, next UTC deadline, bench released. Each attempt directory exclusive-create; preserve crash/incomplete artifacts and stop rather than overwrite/retry a fatal run.
deferrals.schedule: Initial probe plus at most4 retries. Wait at least1800seconds after each failed eligibility probe ends, with no bench lock/board/service held. Persist deadlines across process restarts; no rapid polling probes. Stop exhausted after probe5. Stop immediately after the ONE scored campaign starts, irrespective of its result. No automatic new attempt4.

review.required_before_use: Astra reviews derivation, complete fixed-window denominator/coverage, absence of audio-idle exclusions, strict<0.5% boundary, health fail-closed behavior, persisted deferrals and no scored retries. Freeze plan/runner/bot/fixture/budget/image/prior-failure hashes in evidence before first probe; existing historical bindings unchanged.
review.implementation_scope: This commit is host-only declaration and numerical/scheduler helpers. It has no serial, process, bench or scored execution entry point. The actual acquisition/launch integration must be reviewed against this protocol before use.
review.interpretation: A old/new/old1.499/2.220/3.281% and0source>60ms gaps support no measured9936 send-cadence regression. The exact RF/lwIP/AP/host lower-path cause remains unresolved. Conditional clean-RF selection is disclosed and does not erase failures or estimate uncontrolled-environment reliability. Independent raw Astra audit after any campaign.
